candidates.reason: Just the original banner shrunk into the middle of the tall canvas: the headline is tiny and hard to read, the orange band is a thin strip, and the top and bottom thirds are empty white. Nothing was rearranged.

About 150px of empty white at the bottom against a thin top margin leaves the layout lopsided.

The cleanest of the four: headline legible with comfortable side margins, photo inset with even margins. Still loses the original's photo-behind-band layering, and roughly 160px of empty white at the bottom (versus about 65px at the top) leaves it bottom-heavy and unfinished.

Same structure as candidate 3, but the photo is shrunk and inset more deeply, so its margins don't match the full-width band. That makes the empty white space at the bottom even bigger, and the pizza imagery feels minor.
